_note: pnpm overrides merged into upstream's pnpm-workspace.yaml (an entry with the same key replaces upstream's) for the Node ingestion server's production dependencies: each raises a package with a fixable critical, high or medium advisory (the public grade counts fixable mediums) to the lowest fixed version, inside its own major line where one exists. Measured with grype on this kit's image (2026-10-22).

_why.@temporalio/*: 1.15.0's core-bridge native module bundles quinn-proto 0.11.13 and rustls-webpki 0.103.9 (fixable HIGH); 1.22.0 bundles 0.11.15 / 0.103.13. Same 1.x line (the one source line 1.16+ would refuse to compile, in the recording rasterizer, is not built: Dockerfile.vendor)
_why.thrift: 0.21.0 -> 0.23.0: GHSA-r67j-r569-jrwp; 0.23.0 -> 0.25.0 (2026-11-11): CVE-2026-83745, CVE-2026-86535, CVE-2026-94645, CVE-2026-94646, CVE-2026-96294 (high, fixed 0.25.0; grype, the daily scan of 2026-11-11 on r4). npm thrift 0.25.0 was published 2026-09-30, past upstream's 7-day minimumReleaseAge
_why.uuid: 8.0.0 (aws-sdk v2), 8.3.2 (@google-cloud/storage 5, teeny-request 7), 9.0.1 (gaxios 6, google-gax 4) -> 11.1.1: a medium advisory with no fix before 11; every dependent requires uuid's CommonJS v4/v1 exports, which 11 still provides
_why.@opentelemetry/*: instrumentation packages raised to the fixed minor (0.x: the caret keeps the minor), core 2.x to 2.8.0
_why.zod: 4.3.6 -> 4.6.6: CVE-2023-54404 (high, affected < 4.6.6; Docker Scout 2026-10-23, chain 630 verdict). Its other copy, zod 3.25.76 (chromium-bidi 14, puppeteer's), has no 3.x fix: puppeteer is not shipped (Dockerfile.vendor, the recording rasterizer); async 0.2.10 (fluent-ffmpeg, puppeteer-capture's) left with it, so its floor was dropped
_why.node-forge: 1.4.0 (google-p12-pem 3.1.4, which requires ^1.3.1) -> 1.4.1: CVE-2026-119188, CVE-2026-119187, CVE-2026-118782, CVE-2026-118779, CVE-2026-119190 (high, fixed 1.4.1; Docker Scout 2026-11-01, chain 804 verdict). Keyed `node-forge` so it replaces upstream's own override node-forge >=1.4.0, which 1.4.0 satisfied
_why.fast-xml-parser: keyed `fast-xml-parser@^4` and `fast-xml-parser@^5` so they replace upstream's own overrides (>=4.5.4 and >=5.3.5): under the key `fast-xml-parser@>=5 <5.7.0` upstream's won for @aws-sdk/core 3.806.0 (declares 4.4.1) and @aws-sdk/xml-builder 3.972.0 (declares 5.2.5), whose 5.5.6 shipped in r1-r3 with GHSA-jp2q-39xq-3w4g and GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6 (moderate, fixed 5.5.7 / 5.7.0; 4.5.7, the last 4.x, still has GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6, so both stay on the 5.x line upstream's overrides already gave them); found by npm_floors_check.py on r3's SBOM, 2026-11-01
_why.minimum_release_age_exclude: upstream's pnpm-workspace.yaml refuses versions published in the last 7 days (minimumReleaseAge 10080, at install time); a CVE fix newer than that is added to its minimumReleaseAgeExclude by exact version, as upstream does for its own packages: body-parser 2.4.0 (2026-10-22), node-forge 1.4.1 (2026-10-27T04:44Z; 1.4.2, 2026-10-27T14:09Z, matures on 2026-11-03 and is taken from then on)
